dependency_separation.descent: Canonical rational reflection plus the exact local polynomiality and all-order reciprocal interface.
dependency_separation.polynomial_inner_map: Descent plus both the retained minimum-D lower bound and its unique equality classification. Neither alone replaces the full argument.
dependency_separation.infinity_and_degrees: Exact pullback orders and reciprocal trace; no new external theorem.
dependency_separation.height_one_residues: Elementary rational integration by partial fractions and the retained all-order endpoint identity.
dependency_separation.repeated_pole_family: Exact critical location, reciprocal pole cap and elementary rational algebraic-integer trace of a root of unity.
dependency_separation.Cayley_equivalence: Laurent integration, reciprocal symmetry, marked normalization and all finite local polynomiality orders.
dependency_separation.bounded_diagnostic: A proved factorial-ratio polynomial identity and complete exact rational factorizations; no m cutoff and no extension beyond the stated n/divisor domain.

computed_domain.divisors: All 44 monic reciprocal Q-divisors of r^n+1 excluding r+1.
computed_domain.pole_orders: Every integer m, classified by exact roots of the cleared polynomial and checked against the factorial domain and m>=3(n-1).

review_scope.arithmetic: Authored the global descent, polynomial-inner-map dichotomy, infinity restrictions and canonical combined proof.
review_scope.moments: Independently read the full initial descent proof; derived and checked the exact Cayley converse and wrote the finite checker.
review_scope.jacobian: Independently reviewed the Cayley criterion and reconstructed all 44 retained factorizations and complete integer-root lists; no broader search or universal proof claimed.
review_scope.root: Read the descent, Cayley proof, retained minimum-degree proof and checker; supplied and checked the all-height repeated-pole exclusion. Final source review and separate current-byte replay are retained separately.
review_scope.assurance: Correlated internal AI-assisted proof reviews and exact computational evidence; not external human review or formal verification.

remaining_obligation: Prove that no nontrivial normalized pure polynomial odd-return core exists, or construct one. The present reduction, family exclusion and bounded diagnostic do neither.
not_claimed: Universal no-direction rigidity at every height
An unrestricted cyclotomic coefficient nonvanishing theorem
Finite controls establish the global reduction
